subject: EU-only processing & private VPC - evidence and implementation discussion
messages:
From: Claire O'Reilly <claire@vitalhealth.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>; Procurement Team <procurement@vitalhealth.co>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: EU-only processing and private VPC — evidence & timeline

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week. VitalHealth is moving toward a procurement decision but we have a few gating compliance questions before we proceed:

- Can Redwood commit to EU-only processing for customer data (no egress to non-EU regions) for production workloads? We need a contractual commitment and a description of enforcement controls.
- For high-risk PHI workloads, does Redwood offer a private VPC/on-prem option with customer-managed networking and an option for a BAA?
- Please provide latest copies of SOC 2 Type II (redacted OK), SIG questionnaire or CAIQ, and any evidence for encryption at rest/in transit and key management.
- We will likely need support for SCCs (standard contractual clauses) or a DPA addendum that references SCCs. Do you help customers with DPIA inputs and supporting artifacts?
- Target timeline: two weeks for evidence and a technical architecture review.

Can you share a reference architecture for the VPC deployment and a draft of your DPA? Also confirm whether any runtime caches or metadata (KV caches, logs) could be routed outside the EU under normal operations.

Thanks,
Claire O'Reilly
Head of Compliance, VitalHealth
claire@vitalhealth.co
[Attachment: VitalHealth_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Reilly <claire@vitalhealth.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only processing and private VPC — evidence & timeline

Claire,

Appreciate the clear list — and congrats on getting this far. Short answers up front: yes, we can support EU-only processing for production workloads and we offer Private (VPC) deployments that meet healthcare/regulatory needs; we can discuss BAA options for Private customers.

Next steps we propose (we can adjust in a call):
- Share: redacted SOC 2 Type II, CAIQ export, and a draft DPA that includes SCCs references (attached).
- Technical call: deep-dive on VPC reference architecture (we'll send diagrams) and KV/cache behavior (how we handle prefix/KV caching and region affinity).
- DPIA support: our privacy team will provide a short DPIA input pack (data flows, risk mitigations, controls mapping).
- Action owner: Evelyn to manage the security evidence and Marissa to coordinate timelines/contract.

Attachments included: redwood_dpa_draft.docx, redwood_vpc_reference_arch.png, SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf.

On the technical points you called out:
- EU-only commitment: For Hosted API customers we offer a regional routing policy that pins requests to EU regions; logs and telemetry for EU-routing customers are retained in-region by default. For strict EU-only guarantees we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated with regional lock — we can add a contractual data residency addendum.
- KV cache/metadata: runtime KV caches are stored on the serving nodes in the same region. For Private/Dedicated deployments there is no cross-region replication unless explicitly configured.
- SCCs/DPA/DPIA: we'll provide the DPA draft and SCCs language; our privacy team will produce DPIA artifacts to help you complete your assessment.
- HIPAA/BAA: For PHI workloads we require Private deployment plus a signed BAA. We'll share our BAA template under NDA.

Proposed meeting slots (CEST): Tue 2026-05-04 09:00, Tue 2026-05-04 15:00, Wed 2026-05-05 11:00. Please pick one and we'll confirm.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood_dpa_draft.docx]
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_reference_arch.png]

From: Claire O'Reilly <claire@vitalhealth.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T08:24:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only processing and private VPC — evidence & timeline

Thanks Rishi — that all sounds good. A few follow-ups from procurement/security before we lock a meeting:

- Data deletion / export: VitalHealth requires a contractual SLA for data deletion and an export procedure that guarantees all customer data (including model inputs and derived artifacts) can be exported and purged within 30 days of request. Can Redwood commit to this for Private/Dedicated customers?
- Audit logs: we need audit logs for all admin actions and data access, stored in-region for at least 2 years. Can you confirm retention and whether logs can be shipped to our S3 in eu-west-1?
- Tokenization/KV caching concerns: please confirm whether any caches or telemetry could ever fall back to a non-EU failover region during an outage. We need a hard guarantee or a documented fallback policy.
- SOC2: we will accept a redacted SOC 2 Type II; please confirm the reporting period.

Preferred meeting: Tue 2026-05-04 15:00 CEST. We also need a short mutual action plan with owners and deliverables.

Claire

Mutual action plan (short):

- By 2026-05-06: Redwood to provide DPIA input pack and SCCs language for DPA (Evelyn).
- By 2026-05-06: Marissa to circulate pricing and Private/Dedicated onboarding checklist.
- By 2026-05-12: Technical deep-dive call to review VPC reference arch and confirm no cross-region cache failover unless explicitly requested.

Answers inline to your specific asks:
- Data deletion/export: For Private/Dedicated customers we will commit to a contractual 30-day purge SLA for customer data (includes inputs and derived artifacts). We'll include the clause in the DPA addendum.
- Audit logs: We can retain admin/data-access logs in-region for 2 years and can deliver log export to your S3 (eu-west-1) subject to minimal onboarding configuration and connectivity tests.
- Cache/failover policy: Default for Private/Dedicated is strict regional affinity with no automatic cross-region failover. For Hosted customers we offer region routing with documented fallback policies; we will provide explicit language and controls in the DPA.
- SOC2: attached is the redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-15.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (Evelyn), redwood_dpa_draft.docx (legal), redwood_vpc_reference_arch.png (architecture).

Next: Evelyn will follow up with the DPIA pack and evidence mapping. Marissa will ping you on procurement timeline and onboarding steps. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Rishi
